name.ja: Sod衝撃波管：Godunov型更新と自己相似解
name.en: Sod shock tube: Godunov-type update and self-similar reference

scope.ja: γ=1.4、左右(ρ,u,p)=(1,0,1)/(0.125,0,0.1)、初期不連続x=0.5、t=0.2の標準問題。80/160セルの区分一定Godunov型＋HLLC＋SSPRK3を自己相似Euler解と比較する。
scope.en: Standard γ=1.4 Sod tube with left/right (ρ,u,p)=(1,0,1)/(0.125,0,0.1), initial jump x=0.5 and t=0.2. Compare 80/160-cell piecewise-constant Godunov-type/HLLC/SSPRK3 updates with a self-similar Euler solution.

assumptions.ja: 理想気体、1次元一様格子、正の密度・圧力、CFL=0.3。名付き標準問題の物理定義はJSONに明示し、異なる定義は拒否する。参照の圧力は既存exact_eulerの区間二分法で評価する。Godunov原報の厳密Riemann一段更新そのものではない。
assumptions.en: Perfect gas, one-dimensional uniform grid, positive density/pressure and CFL=0.3. The named benchmark's physical definition is explicit in JSON; incompatible definitions are rejected. Reference pressure is evaluated by the existing exact_euler bracketed bisection. This is not the original exact-Riemann one-step Godunov algorithm.

units.ja: 密度・速度・圧力・長さ・時間は無次元。エネルギーはE=p/(γ−1)+ρu²/2。
units.en: Density, velocity, pressure, length and time are nondimensional. Energy is E=p/(γ−1)+ρu²/2.

boundaries.ja: 両端は端値外挿。波が端へ達しないt≤0.2を対象に、総量変化からT(F_left−F_right)を引く。初速0でも圧力差により全運動量は変化する。
boundaries.en: Edge-extrapolated boundaries. For t≤0.2, before the wave fan reaches the ends, subtract T(F_left−F_right) from integral changes. Unequal pressures cause a nonzero total-momentum change despite zero initial velocity.

description.ja: 細格子160セルの各中心でρ,u,pと同位置・同時刻の参照値を併記。初期値も点サンプルをセル値として与える既存solverを使う。解析的な波構造を使うが、圧力根の数値評価を含み、別コードベースとの独立照合ではない。
description.en: Each of the 160 fine-grid centers carries ρ,u,p and reference values at the same time/location. The existing solver also initializes its cell values from point samples. Wave structure is analytic but reference pressure requires a numerical root; this is not a cross-check against an independent codebase.

description.ja: Sod衝撃波管の比較課題の出典。参照は本配布版の理想気体Riemann評価であり、原論文の数値表の転記ではない。
description.en: Benchmark provenance for the Sod shock tube. The reference uses the edition's ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, not transcribed paper tables.

description.ja: HLLCの接触波復元の原報。公開実装ではDavis型外側波速を用いる。
description.en: Original HLLC contact-restoration paper; the released implementation uses Davis-type outer speeds.

failure_scope.ja: 密度誤差0.035と誤差比0.85は既存Sodテストの80/160セル基準を引き継ぐ。CSVの参照はセル中心で評価した自己相似解との標本比較で、厳密セル平均との誤差ではない。全問題での正値性・エントロピー保証、真空、非理想気体や原報の全計算再現は含まない。
failure_scope.en: Density-error 0.035 and error-ratio 0.85 thresholds follow the existing 80/160-cell Sod test. CSV comparisons use the self-similar reference sampled at cell centers, not exact cell-average errors. No all-problem positivity/entropy guarantee, vacuum/nonideal-gas support or reproduction of all original experiments is claimed.

reference_notes.ja: 細格子160セルの各中心でρ,u,pと同位置・同時刻の参照値を併記。初期値も点サンプルをセル値として与える既存solverを使う。解析的な波構造を使うが、圧力根の数値評価を含み、別コードベースとの独立照合ではない。
reference_notes.en: Each of the 160 fine-grid centers carries ρ,u,p and reference values at the same time/location. The existing solver also initializes its cell values from point samples. Wave structure is analytic but reference pressure requires a numerical root; this is not a cross-check against an independent codebase.

scope.en: Original code is MIT. Inputs, numerical data, figures and prose retain the site’s item-specific terms. This registry does not expand reuse permissions.

description.ja: 自己相似Riemann解に対する密度L1標本誤差が0.035未満（既存Sod検査と同じ基準）。
description.en: Density L1 sample error against the self-similar Riemann solution is at most 0.035, matching the existing Sod-test criterion.

description.ja: 80→160セルで密度誤差が15%以上減る（既存検査の基準）。
description.en: Density error decreases by at least 15% from 80 to 160 cells, following the existing test criterion.

description.ja: 遠方の物理境界流束を差し引いた相対収支誤差。
description.en: Relative integral balance defect after subtracting physical far-field boundary fluxes.

description.en: The requested final time is reached.

title.ja: Sod衝撃波管：Godunov型更新と自己相似解
title.en: Sod shock tube: Godunov-type update and self-similar reference

outcome.ja: Sod衝撃波管を自己相似Riemann解と比べ、密度誤差の減少・正値性・境界流束を含む収支を確認する。
outcome.en: Compare the Sod shock tube with a self-similar Riemann solution; check decreasing density error, positivity and boundary-flux balances.

latex: U_t+F(U)_x=0,\quad U=(\rho,\rho v,E)^{\mathsf T},\quad p=(\gamma-1)\left(E-\frac{\rho v^2}{2}\right)

note.ja: x=0.5の不連続、[0,1]の流出境界、t=0.2。Godunov型有限体積更新の数値流束は近似HLLC。参照は別の自己相似Riemann式で、星領域圧力には数値求根を使う。
note.en: Jump at x=0.5, outflow boundaries on [0,1], t=0.2. Godunov-type finite volumes use approximate HLLC fluxes. The separate self-similar Riemann reference uses numerical root finding for star pressure.
